title: Very poor update
body:
Been using the app for 4 years. Always enjoyed its functionality and easy use. I don’t understand why you would change that. The new interface is horrible. There is no total focus time on the apps home screen anymore. I also don’t like how you select the time. Also on iPhone the lock screen widget and control screen widget isn’t working right, need to fix that. I have no large problem with the design itself but it should function like it did before. Please bring back the total focus time on the apps Home Screen, the length selection was also much better before. And get the widget to work again please. 
Kind regards

body:

Once the timer ends there is no sound whatsoever that tells you that you’ve completed your session. I’ve tried with and without the ambience sounds, hoping that it also enables timer sound, but no. I’ve searched the settings over and over, but couldn’t find anything, so please help me. Am I missing something? Is there a way to get a timer sound to remind me that my work time is done? Paying for this app, I expected at least a functioning timer with its appropriate sounds.
Thank you

title: Good App BUT…
body:
… no notifications when the time runs out?
Tested it on my iPad with iPadOS 16 and iPhone with iOS 15. Both are not getting notifications when the timer hits 0, notifications are enabled in the app and in the system settings. No low battery mode enabled, not silenced, phone not on focus mode, no airplane mode, etc. - like I really tried everything to get notifications but it won’t work. So sadly the timer runs out without me knowing or I have to constantly check the phone which is exactly what I don’t want to do. This makes the app unusable.

Also there is no pomodoro function (4x25/5 and then 30 mins break).

title: Empfehlenswert
body: Ich habe schon lange darüber nachgedacht mir diese App zu holen, da ich zwar eine gute Schülerin bin, mir jedoch das Konzentriert bleiben sichtlich schwerfällt. Auch im Alltag werde ich oft von meinem Handy abgelenkt. Zum Beispiel beim Aufräumen oder beim Sport. Mich selbst plagt es sehr. Diese App ist tatsächlich motivierend und hat viele Optionen mit denen du diese App mehr oder weniger personalisieren kannst. Besonders gut gefällt mir das Tool mit dem du einen echten Baum pflanzen kannst und dadurch den Menschen helfen kannst. Außerdem finde ich es toll dass man nur einmal zahlt und kein Abo anfangen muss. Im Großen und Ganzen ist diese App eine Win Win Situation!

title: Good, but improvable
body:
Dear developers,
I have been using your app for a few days now and I quite like it. 
However, there are some issues/suggestions I would like to leave:

Firstly, please add a setting to automatically enable Do Not Disturb when using DeepFocus-Mode. My Apple Watch still rings when I am planting.

Secondly, please improve you Watch app. It would be amazing to just have a quick toggle for focusing - which starts the last set timer for the last set focus reason. And, also, please add the timer value to the Watch app.

Thirdly, please make quick-toggles for the types of focussing available. Like, the title „Learning“ and a certain type of tree together as a quick button so I don‘t waste time trying to change that.

Your app is awesome. 
Cheers!

title: Tolle App mit 2 Mänglen
body: Tolle App um gut zu lernen und konzentriert zu bleiben. 2 Festures fehlen mir allerdings stark. 1.: Die Möglichkeit, Apps die man zum lernen benötigt (z.B. eine Übersetzer oder Karteikarten App) auszuschließen und diese benutzen zu können, ohne dass die Pflanze stirbt. 2.: Sich eigene Zeiten setzen zu können. Die niedrigste Zeit sind z.B. 10 Minuten. Wenn ich allerdings nur 5 Minuten für etwas brauche, kann man das nicht einstellen. Oder Zeiten zwischen zwei vorher festgelegten. Der 1. Punkt wäre wirklich sehr sehr praktisch, der zweite ist sowieso nur eine Nebensache. Trotzdem richtig tolle App, die ich jeden Tag nutze :)

title: Wirklich hilfreich, obwohl man einige Dinge noch verbessern könnte
body:
Die App ist super und motiviert einen wirklich einmal das Handy wegzulegen und sich auf eine Sache zu konzentrieren.
Auch die Funktion der Gruppe ist total klasse! Allerdings würde ich mir wünschen, dass man nicht jedes Mal eine neue Gruppe erstellen müsste sondern zum Beispiel immer in die Gruppe „Zusammen lernen“ gehen könnte und die zusammen gelernten Minuten angezeigt werden.
Außerdem finde ich es kontraproduktiv und ein wenig störend, dass man sobald mein einen Baum kauft, sich die Preise erhöhen und die konzentrierten Minuten weniger wert sind. Das gehört auf jeden Fall geändert, weil ich mich dadurch nicht mehr motiviert fühle, sondern mich eher frage warum ich für 5 Münzen überhaupt die App verwenden sollte.

title: New UI is unusable
body: After over 5 years of using Forest, I am sadly looking elsewhere. Up until a recent update, I have enjoyed the UI, especially having the visual timer setup, the view of the Forest, and integrations with my lock screen widget. Since the new update, the UI is incredibly laggy, it takes multiple clicks to navigate with planting trees (which has resulted me in accidentally cancelling the session multiple times), and the widget persistently appearing on my lock screen even when there are no active sessions. When I expressed my concerns I was met with a Generative AI response. The lack of transparency about the use of Generative AI is concerning to say the least. The fact that being a Pro member is not enough to have a workable application feels misleading, especially as they have now introduced their Plus subscription tier. Very disappointed. It would have been good to have the option to revert back to the Classic UI. And I cannot get a refund for Pro as it is appearing as ineligible under Apple’s ‘Report a Problem’ page.

body: I have been using forest for over a decade now and initially purchased it. What started as a simple timer app has devolved into a cash grab. Given I have been using forest for so long, I have accumulated many coins and have nothing left to purchase. I can’t purchase anymore real trees and I don’t have the option to convert my coins to time crystals. I don’t mind that there are no more coin items to purchase, but it’s a shame that so many trees are only able to be purchased with time crystals that you would need to spend real money on. I am disappointed with what this app has become. I hope they consider the feedback and return the app to its simpler format.

title: From One-Time Purchase to Paywall Hell
body:
I’m beyond frustrated with what Forest has become. I bought this app as a one-time purchase years ago when it was simple, motivating, and satisfying. Back then, you could actually enjoy the full experience — growing trees, collecting plants, and feeling rewarded for staying focused.

Now? It’s subscription-based, riddled with locked content, and honestly feels like a completely different app. They love to say “everything is as it was,” but that’s simply not true.
	•	Plants and rewards that were once part of the fun are now hidden behind paywalls.
	•	Core features like whitelist mode and longer timers are restricted unless you pay extra.
	•	Updates keep breaking things — crashes, weird bugs, focus challenges not working.
	•	And worst of all, loyal users who supported the app early (and paid up front!) are left feeling ripped off.

It’s exhausting and disheartening. Instead of enhancing the experience, Forest has chipped away at what made it special. The app went from being a clever, one-time investment in productivity to a nickel-and-diming subscription trap.

I regret recommending it in the past, because the version I loved no longer exists.

title: long term user- very satisfied
body:
I love this app. I bought this app for .99c when it dropped and I only used it a few times in 2018. 
I had 2 trees. I now have 158 trees and 63 hours of focus time! 
I recommend the full version for those who struggle to “grind” to get pretty flowers. 
The addition of time guard (locking apps you selected to be locked at certain times of day) is fantastic and has changed my life in the short time it has been released. I’m looking forward to any developments with this the most and I love it’s still located in the forest app and not advertised as a seperate app. Very on brand. 
the full/paid version allowing the planting of trees in the subscription as well as being able to purchase with coins is one of my favourite features. 
Thank you! I hope to see updates becoming more regular for things like the focus challenge as it encourages and gamifies getting back on track. Much more so than a regular study timer. 
please please add in more grasses, I love seeing green in my forest and there are limited

As for suggestions I’d love to see a pause button cause usually I’ll have to get up and do something (e.g walk the dog), but I get why it isn’t available. I’d love to see a dark themed mode on the app, maybe more plants and seasonal themes. Even adding some birds or smth to make the forests feel more alive would be cute.

Thank you for the app developers 🫶

title: Better quality study and better time spent
body:
Pomodoro technique is good and all, but only if it works. Forest actually makes it work. It taps into your screen time setting so most other apps are blocked. You can give up on the timer for sure, but doing so makes this tree—that you’ve been trying to grow for 25 minutes—wilt in your garden.

All it really takes to divert your dopamine centres is a small incentive like this.

Plus you can work collaboratively where if either of you gives up the tree wilts on both apps. Hold everyone accountable

title: It’s good but could be better
body:
The graphics are nice, helps to keep me focused and motivated to stay on task as the more coins I collect, the more plants I can buy.

However, it loses points for not having better features that were available in a similar free app I used before this.
I think it should have these features that the free app had:
- kills your tree (if only this was optional) if you leave the app to browse your phone
- tells you when the time will be when you finish your task
- you can input how long you want to spend on a task in total eg if it is 10h of study, you can use the app to break this 10h into chunks of time to focus

Another upgrade I would love is not available in any focus app I’ve seen but would be amazing to attach a the tasks to a calendar. That way I can organise a planner and for every task, I could use the forest timer to stay focussed and productive. I would pay a bit more for this option.

title: Great app! Heres a few suggestions
body:
Just got this app and love it! I was struggling with motivation to study and was becoming depressed. After listening to an andrew huberman podcast about dopamine I decided to do a detox from the things i was using to procrastinate. This alongside using forest has finally made study feel rewarding.  A few little recommendations,
-  i love the timeline feature and was wondering if the developers could allow us to attach photos, that would be awesome!
- also i feel that it would be much more satisfying to see your forest grow progressively instead of just adding another full grown tree. Then you would also be able to see which trees were planted first as they would be the biggest. Doing this would make it look more like a realistic forest. And the only time the trees would grow, is when ur in deep focus or using the stopwatch, further incentivising the user to focus! 

Let me know want you think, that would be great. I love this app and want to see it grow… see what i did there ;)

title: Needs in depth customisation.
body:
I’ve been using Forest for ages and have been happy with it, but I do have some feedback to the developers.

1. There has been new study research suggest the 52/17 rule (52 mins on, 17 mins off) works better for motivation, creativity and productivity. Currently Forest does not allow for that type of customisation. It would be great if we can choose specific timers instead of by 5s. 

2. Gamify the planting
With the current generation loving games, it would be perfect if we could choose where to plant the trees as that would make it look aesthetically pleasing. Additional benefit for the company as users can put a specific hashtag to tag Forest and give more influence whilst still feeling accomplished. To combat the problem of spending too much time picking where to plant the trees, give users a 20-30second timer to choose where to plant, or else the system will automatically plant trees for users. 

Hope this helps, cheers 💖

title: Good App! :-)
body:
The design and UI is very minimalist and easy to understand. It’s very motivating to be able to track your progress all in one spot and to have a physical/virtual representation of your study habits. 
Only complaint:
I wish there were more features especially for the price point. 
I love the app and supporting charity is amazing, I just wish that the interface was more engaging. It’s a study/productivity app of course, but it would be nice to have more than one way to track your progress on this app. In simple terms, this app feels very one-dimensional and only serves a single purpose. 

If you’re looking for a very clean, practical, ad-free and relatively affordable productivity tracker then this app would be great for you.
If you get bored of apps easily and want a highly engaging way to track your study habits, this app may not be the best fit for you!

title: Was great, but updates have ruined it
body:
I first downloaded this app in early 2022 and it worked exactly as advertised and did exactly what I needed. Strongly discouraged phone distractions and improved productivity. Now in the last couple of months I found I’ve been able to browse all my other apps on my phone without the usual consequences: no more notification telling me to stop, and no more withered dead tree. This defeats the purpose of having the app. There are several people on Reddit and other platforms complaining of the exact same problem! What’s the point of this app if it fails at a core feature? 
The “deep focus” mode doesn’t work, and in any case, having to mess around with Allowed Apps lists is too complicated (and according to my research, doesn’t work on iPhones anyway!) 

The updates are a failure. Give us the old version back. If not, I’ll probably delete soon, and look for something better.

title: No other app like it

title: Amazing but bug error causing my tree to wilt
body: I have only had this app for a few days after seeing lots of really good reviews from people with ADHD. I have been so excited to use it and today for the first ever time after finally beating procrastination, I think I have finally found something to not only help me focus but motivate me to actually get started studying! I study on my MacBook and use my phone for forest next to me. It was all going really well until I took a screenshot on my Mac, then the forest app closed itself after around 10 minutes of focus. I wasn’t sure why at the time so I started again, took another screenshot and the same thing happened. I’m not sure if it’s an Apple glitch with the two being linked or if it’s a forest glitch, but it was quite disheartening 😢 I don’t want to turn off the deep focus (leaving the app will cause the tree to wilt) as that keeps me motivated! Great app and I’m excited to keep using it but I hope this issue resolves!

title: Great if you have ADHD
body:
As someone with inattentive ADHD, this app is my bread and butter. I’ve tried other pomodoro apps before to limited success  but the presence of ‘gamification’ (and fact that the trees die if you use your phone really helps motivate me to use it and be more productive.

The inclusion of in app currency means that I can be ‘grinding’ for a particular tree, and that just means spending more time off my phone and getting stuff done.

It would be great if you could ‘whitelist’ certain apps (such as teams) or even set different ‘tree death’ countdowns for them (like 20 secs on Spotify so you can change playlists)

That being said, the lack of that feature is hardly a dealbreaker for what is an awesome app and I understand that this being an app (rather than a computer program or browser extension) it might not be technically possible.

All in all pretty rad

title: Planting Real Trees?
body:
The only reason why I don’t rate this app 5 stars is because, it takes a long, long time to get the 2,500 coins in order to plant a real tree. I’ve had the app for quite some time and have only planted one real tree from the app. 
And also the fact that certain ‘virtual’ trees cost 500 coins, and therefore I’d rather not buy the virtual trees because it takes so long to even get 500 coins, let alone another 2000 to plant a real tree. 
I would suggest that there be two different currencies/points, so coins go towards buying virtual trees, and diamonds or something go towards planting real trees, so that you’re able to both have the fun of having a decorative forest as well as the main reason of the app, for doing your bit to plant trees. And hopefully as well get double points for working an extra hour or something, make it more exciting and be able to earn coins easier.
Thanks

title: App that actually cares about you
body:
You know I was stunned when I first got this app, because:
1. It’s study function is really motivating. It feels like you’re actually slowly but surely building a forest of progress on your own instead of studying sadly away.

2. It’s addons/purchases. Instead of just ‘buying’ coins, it gives you potions where it doubles the rewards you get for your study sessions and so on. This really motivates you to study (relating to my contention that it’s an app that actually cares). Exam season is comi up, and I wouldn’t mind buying the first tier to be honest XD, even though it’s a bit superfluous. 

Though there are things that I really want to see implemented/or changed:

1. The lack of tag colours. Ugh I’m so picky, but it’s the aesthetic of the app that really brought me into this, and it’s so sad that the personalisation colour aspects are so limited. I wish they could have more colours, or shades really. 

2. The 10 minute mark minimum for planting. I understand...what’s the point of 5 minutes? What would that do? But if you’ve heard of pomodori - which is an amazingly popular study method - there’s a five minute break mark in there. I understand it’s hard, with the rewards and all, but it would be so helpful. 

3. This ones superfluous but animals. I’ve seen this request everywhere, and it would be so cool if animals could roam your forest. God...give the forest some life please. These animals could even be planted for gods sake, just please developers if you are there, animals. Please. Just this once, I don’t care about the others.

body:
Studying for medical exams. This app is excellent for helping discipline. It gamifies time spent studying also with a nice feeling building of a forest. It’s definitely led me to study more than I would have without it and helps with a sense of satisfaction.

I find being able to ‘tag’ activities one of the best features, and have used that to keep track of what subjects I am studying most, and will keep an eye out to make sure I’m doing a bit of everything relatively evenly, by looking the pie chart that is automatically produced by this. 

Worth it.

title: Very helpful for people who need help in focusing
body:
For me I wanted to focus more on other things that enjoyed me and that needed to be done. It helps me knows what I need to do and stay focusing when working, but also help me find my old joy in the things that I used to love. 

I love reading and this ended up helping me focus in a way that is helpful and yet entertaining for the individual. Growing plants while focusing on the task at hand makes me feel achieve as I know I am getting things done but also allowing to be planting trees and bushes to grow my tiny forest. 

I would recommend this app for people who are trying to spend less time on their phone and for people who are looking to get help on focusing on other things that matter more than their phone.

author: poisonivy893628

title: Great app!!
body:
This app helped me focus a lot more when studying. I was a bit unsure of paying money for this app, but it is completely worth it!! I used to always pick up my phone during studying to socialise or play games, but now I have no need to because Forest encourages me to stay focused! I would recommend this app to all students who need help to focus, or even just to get off your devices for a certain amount of time! I would also like to suggest two new features. Firstly, it would be nice to be able to decrease but mainly increase the time when you are using it because sometimes I do homework for longer than expected. And secondly, it would be amazing to be able to use study apps such as google classroom or restricted google use (maybe like a category based list like Apple screen time). An easy way of doing this, would be to add a way to edit a list of apps or categories you are allowed to use during the time when you are studying.

Thanks so much!

title: Awesome but...
body: Forest is definitely not a waste of money. It encourages you to sit down and stay focused by growing beautiful virtual trees that can earn you enough coins to grow an actual tree! How cool is that! My problem is though, there’s some sort of bug where whenever I click on the ‘Real Forest’ section, the app clashes and my phone exits from the app. This prohibits me from accessing the feature of growing a real tree which is really disappointing since I’ve been gathering coins to do so. Also, another suggestion is to have the opportunity to purchase lofi music as the sounds, as a lot of people listen to that when they study and if you’re in deep focus mode, you can’t go on another app like YouTube to play it. Someone here on the reviews also mentioned having a more definite sound for the end of the productivity sessions which I completely agree with. It can also be like a couple vibrations. It’s an awesome app with an amazing concept but it would be even better if the bugs are removed and the above suggestions are taken into consideration. It would be great to have a feedback section on the app to easily point out some more improvements that can be made.

title: Changed the app on an update- now totally useless
body: I’ve sadly had to change my rating. This app WAS amazing, so helpful at keeping me focused for uni study and not looking at social media. However, NOW it’s basically useless. They have updated the app so that now, when you exit the app, nothing happens. Your tree doesn’t die, you can use whatever other apps you want. They say it wasn’t working on iOS, yet I never had an issue before. Now, you need to turn on “deep focus” mode in order for it to work as it did before. This requires a passcode (no idea why you’d need that) so if you don’t want one or can’t use one (which I can not), too bad. Totally changed the app, no longer what was signed up for.

title: Surprisingly effective
body: I didn’t think it was worth an actual app just to tell me to split up my study time into easy blocks, but I decided to give it a go after reading the reviews. It definitely reminds me to stay focused and not get distracted by a notification or a random thought leading to a loss of time accidentally scrolling through social media or messaging friends. The only thing I would change is to have a more clear notification for the end of each session. I can get too involved in lectures or videos which means I’m not using the music provided & I never notice when the time is up. I end up going too far over time and feel a bit like a zombie/consume too much content and it’s a bit of a wasted session. If it could flash on and vibrate to notify me of the end of the time, that would give it 5/5 from me.

title: Really helpful, still require self discipline
body:
So I’ve been using this app for quite a while now since it was recommended at a study skills talk at my school. I downloaded it immediately, and since then I’ve found it extremely helpful when I’m trying to knuckle down and get things done. It really gives you the incentive to work for the entire duration of the timer, and then you get a nice pay off afterwards.

The only thing to note is that you need to have the discipline and drive to actually use it, and use it to its full potential. You may be tempted to just not set the timer and trust yourself, or you might want to have a quick look at something and so you let your tree die.

Otherwise, wonderful app, perfect for students who struggle with procrastination and distractions (such as myself).

title: Intriguingly calming
body:
A very simplistically artistic application. It helps with distraction as it makes you almost feel bad that you don’t let your tree grow. I also love the idea that taking a break from your phone, regardless the intent, can be used to help regrow trees. 

The group function of this app is also very helpful as it increases the amount of trees grown and it also promotes distraction free group activities such as study. Study is in my opinion the best use for this app as I sit down knowing I am doing something good for myself, the environment and my phone battery :) 

I also love how much more control it’s given me when it comes to impulsively opening snaps or messages from colleagues, now I just let the notifications roll in and feel really good about it.

title: Really good! Some suggestions though:
body:
First thing out of the way, this a very good app if you struggle with motivation and distraction to help you stay focussed for short or long bursts of time. Is worth the 3 bucks. However, some features I believe would improve the experience are: 

- a way to pause the timer if you need to exit the app for something that doesn’t kill the tree. I guess you could see this as cheating but if you cheat then you’re only really cheating yourself so... This would be extremely helpful for that moment when you’re working on an assignment and suddenly realise that you need the photos you took on your phone which means you can’t continue working on it without killing the tree

- cheaper trees or greater rewards. It takes a ridiculous amount of time to reach 500 coins and hence kind of takes away the incentive to work towards earning them.

Thanks for reading! Hopefully this was helpful

As currently even if I have the Forest app activated on my phone, I get around it by procrastinating on my laptop or on my iPad. Overall it is a very good app that has helped a lot.

title: My kids love it!
body: My kids (6 and 7 y.o) saw me creating my own forest and became very curious about the app. I let them to play around a bit and they got very excited about the whole idea. So I downloaded it onto iPads and the results are amazing. I've added tags like "outdoor play" "reading" "sports" "chores". "Morning routine" etc If the kids start getting distracted I warn them that will have to "cancel" (kill) the growing tree.  That keeps them very motivated. Less time In front of TV and more time for outdoor play, reading, piano. Also we added each other to friends and can see our trees growing, do one task together. Very happy to find a way to motivate girls and make them focus on a task!

title: Fantastic!
body:
This app is SO good. I bought it this afternoon with the hope that I can manufacture some focus in my adult ADHD brain. I’ve completed two plants so far and I can’t wait to start my day tomorrow to use it for a full day. I love that there is also an option of planting real trees with our earned coins too. I’ve set a revenue goal for my business as well, so that when I reach the goal, I will reward myself by buying one of the premium boosters.

I would love to be able to move the different types of trees around, or maybe have a veggie or flower garden option with movable plants, but other than that I think this app is FANTASTIC and worth every penny.

Thank you so much!

title: Keeps me coming back for more!!

title: Love the iPhone app but the watch app isn't working
body:
When I open the watch app (watch series 3 and iPhone xs with all latest updates) you see the Forest grid and when I tap on that it just says "start planting today!".  But there's no way to start planting on the watch app (without going to the phone to start). Which kind of makes the watch app of minimal if any use if you have to have the phone right there to start it? The whole point of the series 3 and 4 Apple watches is that they can be used independently of the phone. 

If I'm getting it wrong or misunderstanding how it works then I'm happy to change the review. Otherwise maybe replace "start planting today" with "open the app on your phone to start planting"?

One tip if possible for the phone app is to allow a whitelist of apps. One of the tasks I do is reading and use Kindle on my phone for that. However the app kills the tree everytime I do that task. However I understand if the limitations of ios means that you can't whitelist.

While I understand this is a good way to build a habit, the developers clearly don’t understand common game mechanics.  I’m a lot less likely to stick with using this app if the quickest way to setup the study environment I desire (tree and sounds I want) involves paying over and over for elixir only to have the silly price increase after each purchase! Try looking into Logarithmic Curves for reward systems instead of constantly making us pay over and over (food for thought).

title: Definitely worth it
body: This app is definitely worth the money! I was a bit hesitant when I first saw it, and I thought it seemed counterintuitive, but it is so useful for studying- I don't know what I'd do without it. Once you set a timer, you can't leave the app or the tree will die, meaning that you're less likely to go on social media or games to procrastinate. Knowing that you have a timer also makes you want to stay focused rather than zoning out, and there is a sense of pride when you see how long you've managed to stay focused for. I managed to study for about three hours on one of the days and didn't feel emotionally or mentally drained because of the ability to set a rest-time timer. I really liked the rest timer because it doesn't let you add more time on once it's up so you can't be tempted to say "just five minutes more" and then not get back to work. When I wasn't using the app, I would procrastinate for hours and relax when I needed to study, but as soon as it was on I got heaps done. I really recommend the app.

title: It’s counterintuitive, but it works
body: I was a bit sceptical about using an app to wean me off IT - but Forest’s main message (‘Stay focussed’) is what it really delivers on. Like having a personal trainer at the gym, it gently encourages you to stay with a sustained task (reading, writing, editing, whatever) without giving in too soon. ‘Just four more minutes ... just three more minutes.’ The app started me at 25 minutes and I’m now stretching that to longer periods of sustained focus (like adding more weights to a familiar routine at the gym). The tree-planting reward? A bit goofy, but at least it’s a fun way to show yourself how many sustained sessions you’ve achieved in a day. The other stats are helpful little rewards too.

title: Put down your phone and experience life!
body:
I find it *so* hard to not constantly check my phone while I'm doing other things; it's distracting and I never put my full attention into any one task at a time.

Now, when I set my Forest timer, I'm growing a tree or a flower or something else beautiful for my garden, so I feel like I mustn't disturb my phone while that is happening.

It helps with work, obviously, but it also helps with things like paying full attention to a tv show I like - I'm not constantly looking up from my phone, saying, 'hang on, what did she just do?' and having to rewind, only to miss the same bit again because I've gone straight back to my phone.

It also helps with socialising and spending time with loved ones. If it's family dinner, I can set my phone for two hours and grow a tree and be much more engaged with the conversation around me. Same with friends - brunch, set my forest for 45 minutes and actually pay attention to what's going on in my friends' lives.

My little sister uses Forest to help her focus on writing her Masters thesis. Two-hour blocks of not touching her phone, and she knocks out twelve pages of writing.

I think if I wanted to go back to writing my novel, Forest would be a useful tool. Don't get distracted by phonecalls and SMS, Facebook, videogames, emails, and Pokemon!

It's such a simple idea, and it works so well. I have traits of OCD and my phone is always at hand, with pages to read and friends to catch up with and game achievements to get... Forest is like a 'calm down' button. The world won't end if you put your phone down for half an hour and focus on other things.

It's a great tool for mindfulness - being aware of the present moment and experiencing things fully without unhelpful distractions.

Anyway, I like it. Thanks, devs.

title: Best app on my phone! But…
body:
Without a doubt the thing that has helped my productivity the most. This concept is profitable for the developers, the users AND the environment. 

A total game changer… but one major flaw is the maximum amount of real trees. Please consider adding an expansion package as in-app purchase, in order to be able to plant more real trees (I’d gladly pay extra for this). I’d wipe the app and Register as a new user but this would also delete all my data from previous years and I don’t want that. Please consider this. It would change EVERYTHING!

title: Fantastic but no Apple Watch functionality
body:
The app is fantastic. A very good take on the pomodoro technique. The option to listen to different sounds is a nice touch. And the gamification mechanism to unlock new trees is effective.

However it’s a shame that there is no way to start the timer on the Apple Watch. Which is weird because the app is essentially a timer. Setting the timer on your watch would make you less prone to be distracted by your phone when you pick it up. 

You can view your forest on the watch, which is nice.

title: Great motivation
body:
If you can’t stay your way from your phone. This may help you to focus. You can see your little plant or tree slowly grow and as the timer goes down. You can use for anything else until it’s grown or you kill your plant. For me it’s just that little extra I needed. If I don’t want to kill my plant, I don’t use my phone until it’s grown. You can see the Forrest you’ve planted (=time spend while not distracted by your phone). It’s rewarding to see and on top of that you get coins to buy other plant so after a while you could have a digital Forrest with lots of variatie. Fun to see 😄
Oh and they have a project where they plant real trees too. 
Only benefits so far.

title: Une application indispensable!
body: Une application simple mais incroyable pour nous forcer à travailler! Elle m'aide au quotidien, je ne peux plus m'en passer! Elle a un concept nouveau, amusant et utile. Une appli que j'ai cherché pendant longtemps, aucune autre ne peut selon moi l'égaler! Elle correspond exactement à mes besoins et à ceux de personnes qui ont du mal à se concentrer sur autre chose que leur téléphone. Elle donne même envie de travailler grâce à son graphisme et ses arbres funs. Une appli également qui a du coeur et qui est engagée auprès d'une association afin de planter des arbres dans la vie réelle! Pour moi, elle vaut vraiment son prix et est indispensable! C'est l'une des rares applications que j'ai acheté et je ne le regrette pas du tout! Juste incroyable! Elle change un quotidien et rend les tâches pénibles, plus agréables et amusantes. Peu connue en Belgique pour l'instant, mais je suis sûre qu'elle pourrait l’être plus avec un peu de pub.. Elle connaîtra un grand succès c'est certain!

title: One small problem
body:
It is an amazing app, I am using this app for 2 years now and it helped me a lot during my final exams and with being more social. Although I would ask if it's possible to fix one small thing. 

I encouraged my friends to download the app so we could study together and take breaks together. The only thing that bothers us is that if you plant a group-three, the person who plants it gets the threes in his garden and the minutes. The other people don't gain minutes or threes which isn't that nice to keep it competitive. They should get the same amount of threes and minutes as the one who planted the three because they also stayed away from their phones! 

I would like to hear from you guys if there is a solution for this problem!  
Thanks in advantage! 

Louis

title: Combine OCD with productivity
body:
This probably saved my exams. Once started, I get a splash of OCD, and don’t want to kill my tree. Wish there were some more of those hilarious / encouraging words, like “Are you sure you want to kill your cute, little tree?” I’d really recommend this app to anyone. 
Just a few recommendations / things why I didn’t go for the five stars:
- there’s a bit of an issue that makes the store inaccessible (keeps loading and then crashes)
- it would be nice to see your tree fluently grow, instead of having it grow in 4 steps
- when you exceed your focused time, the tree doesn’t grow to the next stage, the ‘basic’ version stays
- I’d very much like an improved cooperation between the app on my phone and on my computer. When I’m working on my laptop, I plant a tree in my browser (love the black- and whitelist sites), but nothing stops me from getting on my phone. And I don’t want to cheat and plant 2 trees, ya feel me?

title: New Update Made the App Worst to Use
body:
New update brought a bunch of new bugs and removed very useful features! They did the opposite of a QOL update, we’re moving on to worse paths…

Setting up the time is a hassle now, it’s not a simple nice clean wheel you spin and see your tree progression, now you have to open a separate tab that takes up your whole screen, set your time, close it, tree not looking like you want? Repeat until you guess right because you can’t see your tree while setting up the time. Very annoying for anyone that likes a bit of variety in both time and tree. Also the new time set up system is also buggy, sometimes it will save your time, other times it won’t so you have to open the screen again, set the time again, and hope that this time it will actually stay.

The end screen requires 3 separate screens to actually end your session. Why am I clicking through 3 different screens? Extra unnecessary and useless steps because all 3 screens are basically the same thing. Also because of this the replay button just doesn’t work until you click through all those prompts, so what’s the point?

Notifications for when a session ends are no longer working. If you’re not starting at your screen your phone won’t vibrate or make a sound to let you know your time is up and your tree is done. Yes the live notification still works, but again I’m not starting at my phone when I’m focusing so I wouldn’t see it reach zero regardless, I need my phone to notify me.

Functionality of the app went way down, it’s a terrible user experience now. Bring back all the features you removed, rethink the new useless ones you added and actually listen to user feedback! The new visual look isn’t the problem, it’s the fact the app is unusable now.

Outro ponto é que antes, na página principal, mostrava o tempo que você tinha feito no dia. Agora não aparece mais.

title: Problemas com o plano
body:
Bom dia! Tudo bem? 

Dia 19 de fevereiro eu fiz o teste grátis de 1 semana do Forest, o que deveria acontecer era que um dia antes eu receberia um e-mail informando que estaria perto do fim do teste, porem eu não recebi essa mensagem e no dia eu não tinha o dinheiro. Então eu entrei para cancelar o plano, eu acreditei que tinha dado certo e apaguei minha conta, porém ontem (2 de março) o valor foi cobrado novamente e pago no automático. Hoje eu fui tentar entrar na conta já que o plano foi pago mesmo eu tendo cancelado-o porém a conta esta desativada mesmo que o valor tenha sido pago. Então eu gostaria que devolvessem meu dinheiro.

title: A proposta é boa.
body:
Não há dúvida de que a intenção do aplicativo é ótima, mas não há necessidade de dispor de uma ferramenta que “dobra moedas” se você assistir anúncios e depois “pegar as moedas de volta”. 
Ex.: se eu plantar por 3h irei ganhar 65 moedas. Ao clicar para dobrar moedas e assistir os anúncios, meu prêmio será de 130. Mas assim que recolho e volto para a tela inicial, as 65 moedas dobradas são recolhidas e fico novamente só com 65. 
Não sei se isso ocorre só na versão grátis (que é a minha), mas esse aplicativo não precisa disso.

body: Estou fazendo essa avaliação (o que raramente faço em outros aplicativos) justamente pelo fato de gostar muito do forest. Eu o conheci na pandemia, e desde então vem sendo meu companheiro de estudos. Contudo, creio que exista ainda uma escassez de novos recursos, como na aba de “conquistas”, falta de atualização nas árvores, e poucas dentro do aplicativo também. A exemplo da aba de “notícias” que a última vez que fora atualizada foi em 2019. É um aplicativo muito bom pra quem quer ter foco nos estudos, mas se não se atualizar (fazer uma repaginação no marketing, comunicação da empresa, além de atualizações a cada período de tempo) Vai ficar no passado, não digo isso como uma crítica, e sim como uma admiradora que espera muito disso. Acredito também que o número de acessos possa ter caído nos últimos anos, e o fator principal disso é a falta de investimentos (tanto nas redes sociais quanto dentro do app) vocês não se comunicam com o público nas redes sociais, e se o fazem, é de forma quase que nenhuma. Se querem minha opinião (mesmo que não tenha sido solicitada kkk) invistam em influenciadores no meio de estudos para divulgarem sua empresa, façam mudanças pontuais, acrescentem coisas novas; como uma opção de pausa durante as seções, e não abandonem uma ideia genial por falta de esforço e comprometimento

title: When the First Trees Lose Their Light.
body:
After the shift to a subscription model, something felt quietly misplaced. Those of us who purchased the app in its early days — when it was a trusted companion, bought once and cherished — now stand somewhat overlooked. The new update casts a brighter light on Plus subscribers, while long-time Pro users are left in a corner we never expected to occupy.

Forest has always been about nurturing growth, tending to focus, and letting time bloom. That’s why it stings a little more to see early supporters feeling sidelined. It would be reassuring, even graceful, to see the app extend the same consideration to those who helped plant its first seeds as it now offers to its newest arrivals.

title: I like it but needs improvements
body: It is a good app and the plant gamification is nice and not distracting like focus plant. But the idea that you can set timers up to 120 minutes to have more developed plants and not schedule breaks in between those completely defest the purpose of the pomodoro method, which is to have regular breaks between 20-30 min intervals. So you should be able to have breaks and still be rewarded with those plants, as you are following the focus method, otherwise you are punishing users for following the correct focusing method. In addition, some annoying bugs like timer never setting off when its done - the other app i use (be focused) did not have the same problem no matter the focus, silent and do not disturb configs, so its the app’s problem, not the user’s problem.

No mais, gosto bastante das estatísticas que eles apresentam sobre meu tempo focado. Gosto de ter essa perspectiva temporal e do dia. Me ajuda a ter orgulho do que puder me concentrar no tempo que tive.

Acredito que, no longo termo, isso vá me trazer muitas coisas boas, mesmo que eu não perceba. Muito bom para nós da geração nova e que adoramos “gameficar” nossas atividades.

Acontece que, sempre que tento faze-lo, dá algum erro no caminho e não consigo concluir a compra. Isso me chateia muito e me faz pensar se vale a pena continuar a usa-lo. title: ### Lack of Alert Sound in Pomodoro App Reduces Its Effectiveness
body: When using the pomodoro app, I noticed that it lacks a crucial feature: an alert sound when the timer ends. This functionality is essential because it allows the user to know immediately when the time is up, without the need to constantly check the app. The absence of this feature reduces the effectiveness of the pomodoro method, which relies on well-defined and controlled intervals. Implementing an alert sound would make the user experience much more efficient and satisfying, eliminating the constant worry of checking the timer and allowing for greater focus on tasks.

title: Amo o Forest, mas tenho uma reclamação!
body: Uma das melhores ferramentas criadas foi a de “Foco total”, com a lista de permissões. Entretanto, eu acho que precisa de alguns ajustes. Ao selecionar os aplicativos na lista de permissões, não aparece o Safari (no iOS), apenas alguns dos sites que já visitei (os que preciso realmente usar, não aprecem). Por isso, toda vez que estou no Foco Total e preciso fazer alguma pesquisa no Safari, tenho que parar de plantar para poder pesquisar. Uma atualização nesse quesito ajudaria muito. Obrigada!

title: Produtividade visual
body:
Olhar para as semanas anteriores e ver a floresta cheia é de uma enorme satisfação e motivação para manter assim. 
No início pode parecer bobo, mas com o tempo você muitas vezes vai se encontrar deixando o cronômetro correr mais alguns minutos e estudando/trabalhando um pouco a mais só para plantar mais uma árvore (ou deixar uma árvore diferente surgir). 
No fim, a produtividade depende é da própria pessoa. Mas o Forest permite uma sensação de recompensa muito interessante enquanto fazemos nossas tarefas. 
Sugiro mais troféus e desafios ao app!

title: Absolutely in love!
body: Forest allows you to study better and measure your productive time. In short, all you need to do is choose one of the plants or trees from your library, set a time for it to grow and start doing what you have to do, without losing focus. What I like about it is that it locks the device in a way that if you go out of the app for a few seconds your plant dies. This way, it works like a game. The more time you spend planting trees, your garden begins taking shape. Although it’s paid, it’s worth every penny. I strongly recommend it.

title: Excellent, but lacks a few features
body:
Excellent app, after reading all the great feedback about it I’ve decided to give it a try. It works fine and just like I wanted it to, and when coupled with iOS Focus Mode, it helps me a lot to concentrate on study and work tasks, and that’s exactly the app I was looking for.
There are some features I wish Forest had, such as a button that starts planting a new tree right after finishing a session/break, instead of having to go back to the main screen and then starting a new planting session. Another feature I wish it had is being able to start and control sessions directly from the Apple Watch.

title: Ótimo para manter o foco no estudo
body:
A função de travar a tela do celular é essencial pra ajudar a manter o foco. A jogabilidade com a ideia de formar um jardim é um ponto positivo o mais pois te estimula a completar as tarefas pra receber a recompensa (mesmo que bobo, tem dado certo pra mim!!). Sem dúvida os relatórios de tempo, dias e atividades realizadas são o grande diferencial desse app!! Muito bom mesmo!!! 

Obs: única sugestão é que ao finalizar um tempo de estudo (30min) a opção de “descanso” já apareça na tela automaticamente,  sem eu ter que escolher fazê-la.

title: Melhor aplicativo que eu tenho
body:
Apesar de ter pago um preço pequeno e único pelo app, ele definitivamente valeu muito a pena. Eu melhorei muito a minha rotina de estudos e consigo concentrar só com ele por horas direto!

A cada versão ele melhora e te da até gráficos te mostrando a sua rotina de produtividade. Além disso, você constrói uma floresta linda que é muito gratificante de ver.

E pra completar eu já plantei três árvores reais com esse app, muito bom pro meio ambiente e para a ONG Tree que tem parceria com eles.

Uso esse app a mais ou menos um ano e não trocaria por nada!

title: Tem que melhorar!
body:
Comecei a usar hoje mas já estou gostando, o único ponto que de cara já achei negativo é o fato de que pra IOS não tem a opção de whitelist, então a pessoa é obrigada a não utilizar o “ modo foco total” e isso faz com que perca a graça do aplicativo por que assim a pessoa pode livremente mexer no celular sem a plantinha morrer. E o que me atraiu a usar o app foi o objetivo de bloquear e a plantinha não morrer, mas alguns app tenho a necessidade que sejam livres.
Por favor, melhorem isso, o aplicativo é muito bom pra ter essa falha “boba”.

title: Atualização do IOS
body: Amo o aplicativo e venho usado ha meses, mas desde a última utilização do IOS (13.4.1) ele fica saindo no meu celular constantemente. Sem contar que após o término da marcação do período determinado ele não está marcando mais o tempo extra (se marquei por exemplo 40 minutos ele não conta os minutos que ultrapassei mais). Acredito que isso esteja ocorrendo justamente porque o aplicativo não está ficando aberto, o que tem atrapalhado na utilização dele. Espero que seja feita uma correção pra continuar usufruindo de seus benefícios.

Que o som de alerta ao final da tarefa fosse acionado mesmo se o celular estiver em modo silencioso (em outros apps é assim)

title: Simples, mas funciona
body:
Forest é um aplicativo simples, e fofo: não mexa no seu celular por uma quantia de tempo, e a árvore cresce. Mexa no celular, e ela morre.

É uma mecânica assustadoramente efetiva pra resistir à tentação de pegar no celular sem objetivo, e perder tempo valioso do seu dia, ou das pessoas importantes ao seu redor.

Comprei na época que era pago, e pagaria de novo se precisasse; é muito bem feito, cumpre o que promete, e não te atrapalha.

title: Suggestion: make exceeded time count towards bigger trees!
body:
Excellent app, I would only give two suggestions:
• let us set a tree type to every tag (so we can differentiate our tasks when looking at the forest)

• let exceeded counted time count towards bigger and fuller trees (I’ll always use 25 min as time, but if I do go on 120min straight, I would like a bigger tree in my forest)

title: Insuperável e Indispensável
body:
O melhor app disponível para quem precisa se concentrar. Nos estudos tem efeito surpreendente!

Quando estudamos, diferentemente de outras atividades como pintar um quadro ou completar uma fase de um jogo, a recompensa não é imediata. Estudamos por dias para receber o feedback apenas na hora da prova. Com o Forest, realizar uma sessão de leitura ou estudo proporciona uma recompensa imediata ao fim da atividade, mesmo que seja uma árvore e moedinhas de ouro!

Antes do aplicativo eu estudava pouco, e com uma qualidade inferior, pois me distraia com frequência. Agora utilizo o aplicativo quase diariamente, e meus estudos, além de durarem mais de 2x mais, são mais foçados.

Também é uma ótima oportunidade para momentos com a família e amigos, que pode ficar até 2h longe das redes e aproveitando tempo de qualidade com o próximo!

Enfim, recomendo infinitamente. É um app que todos deveriam ter em seus telefones!

title: UX/UI could improve
body: I love Forest but I think the UX/UI of the app could improve a lot. As a designer it bothers me so much. Also, it is too expensive to buy different types of plants and they are all the same price. If you want to gamificate this part of the app, plants should have different prices, some being cheaper while the best ones are expensive. I hate that when I complete a cycle, I have to click to go back so I can select another time and begin another cycle. Why do I have to go back? It is totally unecessary. Those are some very simple examples as why UX/UI should improve.

everyone should download it!!

title: Forest App
body:
Esse app é maravilhoso! Além de vetar, compulsoriamente, o uso do celular (eu me distraio muito fácil no Instagram), ele traz um gráfico do que você estudou. Isso ajuda (e muito!) a verificar o que está faltando para estudar. 
A ideia de uma competição de “quem estuda mais” também é excelente! Sou muito competitiva, então acabo que isso me impulsiona a focar mais nos meus estudos.
Enfim, esse app é tudo de bom! Super recomendo

title: Sobre o Forest
body: É um aplicativo muito bom para obter produtividade, pois o fato de não podermos sair do aplicativo depois que uma árvore está sendo plantada, acaba com a necessidade de ficar mexendo nas redes sociais. Outra ponto positivo é o fato de ele dar um objetivo para você, pois se você alcança uma certa quantia de dinheiro no jogo, você pode pedir para plantarem uma árvore na vida real para você. Uma dica que eu tenho para melhorarem o aplicativo é terem outros tipos de plantinhas no aplicativo.

I’m absolutely addicted to it. The more you use it the more you discover little details that make it special. The app doesn’t only track time of your activities, but it actually makes you want to do them. When I feel like procrastinating I remember I have achievements to accomplish and cute trees and bushes to buy. 
It also gives you the possibility of “playing” with your friends and see how they’re doing with their responsabilities.
I can only say good things about it.
ps: love the background sounds ❤️
author: Jullie Marrie

title: O melhor investimento da comunidade acadêmica
body:
Estou apaixonadíssima por esse app. A princípio muito cética sobre gastar meu dinheiro por um app - sim, old, eu sei - mas foi o melhor investimento que me ajudou a deixar o celular de lado pra escrever minha pesquisa e trabalhar e ser mais produtiva. 
Se você é como eu e tem dó de matar árvores e adora receber recompensas pra comprar árvores coloridas, esse app é pra você. 
A interface é muito intuitiva e nos dá o necessário, de modo que o app é super tranquilo de utilizar e, ao mesmo tempo, lindão. 
Tenho certeza que você não vai se arrepender quando começar a usar a versão paga :)

title: (Quase) Perfeito
body:
O aplicativo é impecável na sua função de afastar o dono do celular. Você planta uma árvore que será tão grandiosa quanto o tempo investido nela, e para que ela cresça é necessário que o dono não mexa no celular pelo tempo estipulado.
Quando você liga a tela aparecem mensagens como “não olhe para mim” ou “largue o celular” etc. e que te fazem ter um juízo moral de que não pode mexer no celular pois a planta pode morrer.
A recompensa vem quando você olha as árvores plantadas e as estatísticas de quanto tempo você se focou em algo ou não mexeu no celular. Meu rendimento para os estudos e para prestar atenção na aula melhoraram em, eu diria, 300%, senão mais.

Existem dois problemas porém: quando você quer comprar novos tipos de árvores ou arbustos, elas são muito caras (600 moedas), precisam de dias para serem compradas, ou seja, eu acho que o aplicativo deveria recompensar melhor a pessoa por ficar 120 minutos (42 moedas) sem o celular. Ainda o aplicativo deveria ter suporte para o português, que para mim não é um problema, mas para muitas pessoas é.

 Eu comecei a usar para estudar, mas agora uso pra quase tudo (fazer esporte, andar com o cachorro, ler um livro - hábito que eu estava deixando de lado de tanto mexer no celular). É possível classificar a atividade com as tags (estudo, leitura, academia, etc) e ver sua produtividade em cada uma delas ou em todas juntas. É o mais legal é que vc vai ganhando moedas para comprar novas árvores e pode comprará o plantio de uma árvore de verdade!!! 
Poderia ter como colocar um alarme quando o intervalo acabasse, ajudaria muito!!

title: Greatly delivers its promises, but devs are greedy.
body:
This app is really good on the things it claims to do. However, the impression that one gets using it is that all that the devs want from its users is their money. Here's an example:

It is really hard to get coins for unlocking new trees. Each one costs 600 coins, but for a 40 min focus session, you only get 12 or so. And there are at least 10 different trees. It would be nice if I was rewarded for focusing hard and getting more coins as I progress, but there doesn't seem to be the case. But, of course, you can PAY for a bonus, where for a limited amount of time, you get double coins.

This kinda defeats the propose. I have already paid for this app, WHY is there in-app purchase?? Should it incentivize me to be more productive? Instead, you can buy your way to a healthy and pretty forest.

The forest, by itself, means nothing. I mean, I could just turn on the app, go do something non productive and return after a very long time and I would get a full forest. If it seems valueless, why a bought forest would be different?

TL;DR: App's great, but give me ways to get more coins only by being more productive.

title: Every update makes it worse. Do not buy.
body:
Edit: in addition to the below, they have begun forcing ads. Ads on a product I paid for. Unbelievable. Never had a review gradually go from 5 to 1 stars before. I’m done.

For years, this was favourite time-tracking apps. I tracked >12700 hours. I can monitor my progress on my watch, or lock screen, or with a home screen widget (assuming an update hasn’t broken them). Plus I adore the aesthetic style and design choices.

But they keep updating it with feature creep & schemes to sell time crystals. And many updates break key features! They take features I already paid for & lock them behind a monthly subscription.

Now, if it doesn’t connect to wifi for a few hours, it locks me out of a bunch of features! I even get ads. I paid for this app and they’re giving me ads‽‽ 

Finally, it’s simple to export your data as a spreadsheet, which I love for getting deeper into time analysis.

I’m just waiting for the day when they lock “Favourite” trees behind a subscription, or remove the ability to export data… on that day I revise this review to 1 star & finally delete the app.

title: Not what it used to be.
body:
As per usual with apps it has become about optimizing how much money can be made but at the expense of the user experience. I’ll keep using this app for its shamefully limited functions until I find a new one. 

I paid for this app in its early inception and all the functions were free, it did not have a global ranking - which I think is not fostering true productivity as how are people focusing 22 hours of the day. It seems to be incentivizing the wrong things. 

Additionally, the new seekr ID is pretty misleading when you create one you lose all your existing growth history and tree types, along with your coins and gems. 

For anyone who experienced this, I figured out how to retrieve my previous history, just sign out of the seekr id and log back in via your email! It will switch the server back to global which should restore things for you! 

Furthermore, it seems like a huge oversight to have to pay to obtain more coins and gems, maybe those should be rewarded more generously for completing a growth cycle or staying on the app or at least offering that option like the app did at its inception. 

Lastly, it is constantly buggy, my coins will drop randomly and that has not sorted itself for weeks. Tried to contact the help time but they offer zero help! Do better Forest, you seem to have a loose nonexistent understanding of USER EXPERIENCE, I suggest you get your priorities straight.

title: Uncomfortable, forced, and unproductive
body:
I find that this app does the opposite of its intended purpose. While the developers concentrate on new trees and beautiful plants to attract future users, they pay little to no attention to the usability itself. There is no way to pause the timer. There is no way to record work sessions you may have done without the timer. You begin to feel like you can only work if you have this app next to you, because of the “coin” system implemented. Additionally, there are in app purchases! Why are there in app purchases in a pay-to-download productivity app? Absolutely horrifying and this app offers barely any useful features for a premium price of 6.99 CAD, when some other apps offer you a more well thought out, albeit more practical app that legitimately provides a pomodoro timer without so much emphasis on reward.

In order to work effectively, one should never feel the need for virtual trees and coins to incentivize them. 

By the way, if you’re planning on getting this app, let me warn you on a few things: 

- new trees are tedious to unlock (except for in app purchases)
- statistics are basic 
- IT IS RIDICULOUSLY EXPENSIVE TO PLANT TREES IN REAL LIFE (don’t be fooled by their environmental marketing)
- overall unpractical, too focused on in app purchases, and it actually makes you more unproductive and focused on the “game” that is planting pretty trees than your work.

There are better options out there.

title: Good, but needs more motivational/rewarding factors
body:
The idea in of itself is great! Don’t get me wrong, it works decently but it needs a little boost. For example, with some trees the appearance changes the longer you study for and I wish there was more variety in those changes. A lot of the time I’ve noticed 15 minutes and 135 minutes are barely any different. If I could visually see the difference more clearly I would want to yearn for longer study times to get the more “aesthetically pleasing-harder-to-get” tree. The small changes they have in place right now don’t do that for me to be honest. 

Additionally having some sort of game integrated into it with levels and rewards would be super fun.

I think some trees could have specific benefits to it such as a small bonus in coins or if you were to do a game level type of system it could be additional XP to “level up” hypothetically. 

This app is good because it does fulfill its purpose of keeping you off your phone but for it to be excellent, I would try to incorporate ways to make it more fun. Because if it’s more fun to use, it’s more fun to study knowing you’re getting something out of it (more than just a visual of all the trees you have accumulated).

title: Boost your focus with this app
body:
Forest is a visually-appealing and effective application for tackling work or studying.

You can tackle your projects, in chunks of time that you set, at the end of which you will have a new tree or plant in your digital forest.

But if you interrupt the app partway through, by using your phone for anything else. your tree will wither and die.

The more trees you successfully plant and grow, the more species of trees you will be able to plant.

You wouldn’t think this would make much of a difference for your motivation but it does.

title: Deep focus mode issues
body: I used to recommend this app to others, but recently, I found dysfunctionalities of this app after using it more. Like when you are in deep focus mode if you want to turn off your Bluetooth or turn off wifi when your phone is locked, and you don’t even unlock your phone, you will lose a tree. I have AirPods and sometimes it will be connecting between my MacBook and iPhone back and forth. And I’m using my Macbook to study, so I have to turn off the Bluetooth on the phone, and it will reject my deep work and destroy my tree! Hence, in conclusion, this is another social network you must ignore when you want to focus deeply.

title: Great App
body:
It does it’s intended purpose of blocking other phone use and websites. As someone with ADHD, it’s useful for reminding me that I sat down with a purpose so I don’t get sucked away doing other things. 

The mental reward of seeing the forest has gotten old after a few months of using this app. This may not be the case for everyone and I recognize my ADHD means novelty is going to be more motivating. I wish there was more creativity and customization with the forest. 

I think a different points system would be more motivating over the long run. I would like to be able to rearrange the plants and possibly view it differently (Ex: side view versus top down view). 

 Regarding the plant/points system, if points were earned per focus session, then trees/plants that have been unlocked could be purchased and custom placed. I think this would be more exciting and provide a regular mental reward (at least for me). If the cost of plants was scaled, like grasses and basic bushes being inexpensive, and fancier trees being more points to place in the forest, it would encourage me to do more focus sessions to save up the points. I do think unlocking new types of plants is excellent, but these rewards take a long time to save up for and in the meantime, there is little to motivate me to keep using the app. 

 I think also being able to customize the background/colours (maybe based off of the 4 seasons) would provide more visual interest and more incentive to share your forest with others on social media and whatnot. 

 The current set up does not encourage pomodoro technique as the nicest looking trees require a 120 min focus session without structured breaks. This is another reason why I think restructuring the points system would be helpful.

I don’t know anything about coding or programming apps or how difficult/costly implementing these suggestions would be, so please take these as well-meaning suggestions from a still very pleased customer of the app. :)

I saw some other reviews about the messages being “harsh”. I actually like them and it was kind of refreshing to have the firm reminder to get back to what I was doing. If I remember anything in the middle of these focus sessions, I do not close down the app, I’ll just write it on a sticky note and review it after the timer is up.

title: No progression
body:
For the most part i really enjoy using this app but there is a big flaw, and that’s the sense of progression. I’ve been using this app for almost 6 months, (which is a long time to use an app regularly!) and I don’t feel like I’ve been progressing through the content at all.

For example, there are over 50 types of trees in the game and i’ve only gathered enough coins to buy 2. In 6 months of using this app regularly, I’ve only been able to buy 2 trees. To be able to buy all of the trees I’d have to use this app regularly for 13 YEARS. 13 YEARS! It is insane to expect users to play for 13 years in order to get all the trees. Since the customization aspect is such an important part of this app (browsing the store is really the only other thing i do other than plant trees), it really hurts this app when it is done incorrectly.

If I were to change something, I would drastically decrease the cost of the trees, or make it easier to earn coins. It’s hard to nail it down just right, because you risk making earning trees too easy. I think that it should be moderately hard to get trees, but still doable. Being able to buy a tree should take maybe a week’s worth of planting, not 3 months. It should be something that I’m always pushing toward, and I should feel like I’m being rewarded properly for the studying I’ve been doing. It would also be a good idea to add some sort of focus time. Like for instance, earn double coins at a certain time of day. That would be a good motivator to study at a healthy time, since many people tend to study during the night. Maybe you could make it like, at 2pm-4pm planting trees gives double coin rewards. I think that would be a really good idea to implement. 

Anyways, I really like using this app but i think these changes would really help me to stay using it regularly and help bring in more users.

title: Pretty Neat Study Tool!
body:
So far, I’ve used Forest a couple times to help me stay productive and keep focused on my work. It’s a pretty great system, although I’d recommend you use deep focus to make sure your work takes the centre stage rather than your phone. 
The overall app feels well thought out on how it helps you study, and covers for mistakes in case you open the app on accident or start a tree when you didn’t mean to. Plus it doesn’t require you to sign in with Facebook when you use it.
Maybe a way to start Do Not Disturb when you plant a tree could be added in the future, that could be pretty cool!
Overall, great app! Highly recommend it if you have trouble putting your phone away during situations. 

Plus, the trees are all so beautiful it’d hurt to let them die. 5 Stars :)

title: Really love this app.
body: I have used this app as an undergraduate and graduate student, and as a student with ADHD that struggles with executive dysfunction, Forest is a godsend. I highly recommend this app if you have trouble putting down the phone and getting to work on tasks. I only have one suggestion, and I understand the pitfalls that may come with it, but: would really love the ability to select a few apps on my iPad/iPhone that I could use while I’ve got a tree timer going. I often use my iPad as a second screen while working on my thesis and need to access my good notes app to read my annotated journal articles. This prevents me from being able to use Forest when I know I’ll need to access information on my iPad. I’d love to be able to do this but still have Forest to prevent me from opening Twitter, or the NYT, or really anything else other than one or two specified apps related to my task at hand! Awesome app, thank you!

title: The reward doesn’t motivate the habit.
body: At the basis of this app is the stimulation of the rewards system. This makes sense and is an excellent idea to create habits. You perform task X - like studying - you get reward X - a tree. However, where this app falls short for me is in lacking creativity in motivating the reward system. My interest and motivation would much better be peaked if I had the power to customize the forest ie move trees around, create my own “nook” if you will. Here, the most that the app does is lets you pick the type of tree you want to get, and then places it for you. You get a plot of land with the app placing your trees around at random, and their placement for some reason changes every time you open the app. This left me asking “ok so what if I got this virtual tree if I can’t actually create my ‘own’ forest” - the way the app markets it to be. The immersive element is gone. I understand that there may be the need to NOT make it too immersive as it would defeat the purpose of the game, but at least allow a sense of agency in this app by allowing its players to be able to move the trees around the forest space. In addition, the “bigger” reward of planting an actual tree requires a very high, seemingly unattainable amount of coins (which you only get when you grow your trees), so again - this feels more demotivating and unattainable than it is motivating. To sum up, my suggestions would be to give more personalized options to the app user to make it a bit more fun and give an instant sense of reward, and perhaps work on ‘selling’ the real tree planting program better.

title: Amazing - one small improvement
body:
Forest is amazing! It works great and since using it I have noticed a huge improvement in how I study and stay focused. I recently discovered how to make my planting exceed 2 hours and go up to 3, which is great and is super helpful! My only issue is that sometimes when I have my screen locked and then go to open my phone again, the Forest app has closed. This isn’t a problem if I have deep focus turned off or if I’m still in the middle of planting a tree, but when this happens it doesn’t count my exceeded time, which is frustrating because I often don’t check until after and it’s sad to see my focused time wasn’t counted. 
Overall, I love Forest and recommend it to everyone! This is just one small thing that I wish didn’t happen because it’s sad when my exceeded time hasn’t been counting. 
Thanks!

title: Needs a longer tree growing option
body:
We need to be able to set longer than 3 hours, especially for people like me who work longer than that. It should go up to 8 hours as if it's a full time job you are at. Or at least 4. Three is fine but not enough.
If we are using Forest on multiple devices, we should be able to get the right amount of coin from each device (I use Forest to stay off boh my ipad and phone). They told me they only give coin from one, from the first one that finishes, which is stupid and unfair for people like me who are only working harder in my forest. Maybe have a limit of 2 or 3 devices but they should at the least give us the correct amount of coin for each one (I set mine each at 3 hours so I should get 65 coin for both trees)
I actually have an issue lately too. My store isn't loading. Updating the app has fixed it before but I've got the updated version now and it's not opening, therefore I can't buy any new trees. Real forest looks fine but the store just has the loading cicle and nothing else.

title: Could be better
body:
Although it has a nicer design than Flora, it isn’t as convenient.
This is how the app can improve:
1. Allow for friends to join study groups even after the session has started like Flora does. It is annoying having to wait for friends to be ready instead of starting the session.
2. Fix the bug where if we pass the study session time, the timer is still on and adds to the total time. Sometimes it does record the time I exceed sometimes it does not.
3. Make the cosmetic trees a more reasonable price. Doesn’t really make sense for a real tree to be 2500 and for cosmetic trees to be in the hundreds and thousands as well. Remove the burden or making a moral choice between a real tree and decorating our garden by reducing the price of cosmetic trees.

title: Wonderful app!
body:
This app has gotten me (and is still getting me) through countless study sessions in university. The virtual trees are so cute, the coins are good motivation to keep the trees growing, and the real tree feature is so good for the environment! All for a price that is less than a Starbucks specialty drink. 

My one critique keeping this app from getting 5 stars is the new update. In deep focus mode, you’re not even allowed to lock your phone while the tree is planting because that will kill it. I don’t always have access to a plug when I use the app and the last thing I want to do is leave my phone screen running for 25+ minutes at a time. 

I do understand you can turn off deep focus mode, but that kind of defeats the purpose of staying in the app and not killing the tree. Now I force myself to not exit the app when planting a tree, but I do miss using the old “deep focus mode” and being able to lock my phone.

title: Amazing!
body: I love this app! I use it all the time to keep myself off my phone when I am studying or practicing the piano. It is very cute and I highly recommend this app, especially if you procrastinate or check your phone too much like me. However, there are two things I wish this app could have: A timer that is more customizable, as in you can use a keypad to enter how long you want to focus for. Sometimes you need to study for periods longer than two hours and even though you can study until it’s time’s up, you might get distracted before restarting the timer. Also, you might need to change your timer mid-study. Secondly, I wish the app would focus more on encouraging instead of punishment. Sometimes you need to message someone, or need to do something outside of the app, and that means you will be killing your tree. I don’t think that’s very motivating. Even if I wanted to take a break I would have to kill my tree. Plus, a tree GRAVEYARD? That isn’t okay! Maybe a pause/break button would help. That way, you can keep your tree alive, and maybe do whatever it is on your phone. Or maybe a button that would switch you from being able to use your phone or not while you are studying. (I know there is one in the settings, but you can only use the settings if you aren’t focusing which is highly inconvenient).

title: Saved Me During Exam Week
body:
I found this app on a website with study tips, and at first I thought that it wouldn’t help me, as I would not take all other study apps seriously. It sounds bizarre, but Forest is the only one of them all that I actually care about! It’s something about the terrifying experience of losing your progress or killing a tree that keeps you going. During exam week I use this app constantly, and I’ve gotten stellar marks because of it.

If you have trouble sitting down and studying, I recommend spending the $3 on this app and finally getting the focus you want!

title: An essential app for anybody who is prone to distraction
body:
I goddamn love this app. I get really easily distracted with my phone by going on social media apps like Instagram and reddit where I end up scrolling aimlessly for hours on end. But if I simply set a time goal on this app and put my phone down outside of my reach I’m much more likely to work undistracted. 
This app is an absolute game changer for students like myself who don’t have the greatest discipline so they need to implement routines that guide them in the right direction: studying more frequently and for longer lengths of time. 
Also I love the coin system! Defiantly use the coins to unlock the ambient sounds because they are a godsend to listen to while working.

title: C’est... Impressionnant
body:
C’est vraiment une bonne application. Je l’ai trouver dans une émission télé (québécoise) Vous faites d’une appli, un endroit merveilleux pour l’écologie. C’est dur de trouver une app comme la votre. Vous aider la planète, et vois NOUS aider par la même occasion! Je vous félicite de penser à l’environnement. De faire d’un app, un endroit écologique qui fait planter des arbres là où le monde en ont besoin. N’hésitez pas à continuer qu’importe ce qui arrive! Grace à vous, la planète est de mieux en mieux!
Continuez et n’arrêtez JAMAIS!

Un message d’une jeune fille qui veux changer le monde en devenant une pro sur l’écologie et une personne que tous ensemble, nous pouvons changer la pollution, les mauvaises personnes qui pensent qu’à l’argent... Nous, on veux vivre.
